name: Pinnacle Marketing Login Redirect for Ultimate Member
author: pinnaclemarketing

sections.description:
This plugin prevents logged-in users from viewing the Ultimate Member core Login page. If a logged-in user visits the UM Login page, they are redirected to a URL you control in Settings → Login Redirect for Ultimate Member.

Key features:
* Redirect logged-in users away from UM’s core Login page
* Admin settings page to configure the destination URL
* Works with internal paths only (e.g., /home/)
* Safe behavior if Ultimate Member is not active (shows an admin notice; can auto-deactivate)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Login Redirect for Ultimate Member.
  4. Set your Redirect URL and click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
Does this work with custom login pages?

This targets the Ultimate Member core Login page (the page UM designates as its Login core page). If your login form lives on a different page that isn’t set as UM’s core Login page, you would need a small tweak (feel free to request it).

Can I use a relative URL like /home/?

Yes. Relative URLs that start with / are treated as internal paths.

What happens if Ultimate Member is deactivated?

The plugin will automatically deactivate itself and show a one-time notice on the Plugins screen explaining that Ultimate Member is required.
